notes.title: Patch 1.1 Sneak Peek: Shiny Morps, Artifacts, and More!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/818c47ec12bdcf0bf5f27ab99c9723f19f323c24.png

Hello, Interns!
We're getting closer to the release of our first major update since launch. In patch 1.1, we will introduce some fun new features and improvements: you'll finally get to see Shiny Morps in action, dress them up with hats, and enjoy full controller support for a smoother gameplay experience. Keep reading for a sneak peek at what we’re working on right now!

Shinies & Morp-Hats!
We're not just giving you more ways to customize your Morps, but we're also adding more variety to Morps themselves! Pop a hat on your favorite regular Morp, or go all out and dress up a Shiny version to really show off. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/4a6bfc8836f022e68f9ee4a55f5d41d035ed4114.png
The Archive & Artifacts! 
This new mechanic adds a fun side activity for collectors and for players who love keeping a stash of resources, just in case. The Archive is closely tied to Artifacts, which we're also adding to the game. Players will be able to find Artifacts all over the world while performing various activities, then turn them in at the Archive for some cool rewards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/d941e282b6a576c1ba1ddc189e1de0bc7f649d31.png
New Player Skins!
You’ll have the chance to personalize your character even more. Whether you want to create a unique look, new skins will help you truly associate yourself with your in-game persona. It's all about making your character stand out and reflect your style!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/357b5e5af564acc95128e23b57e92e0626c4b9fc.png
More Decor!
It’s going to be easier than ever to make your world feel even more cozy and personal with all new additions of decor. Don’t be shy, let your creativity run wild and build some awesome creations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/307ce9303701c1ecf6a2cbc1d3f0642d0db25d43.png
Controller Support!
The controller support rework is almost complete! With patch 1.1, it’ll be fully integrated into the game, offering a much more immersive experience for controller lovers.

And More!
Balance tweaks, error fixes, other improvements, and more changes for a better gameplay experience!

Discount!
We are celebrating our participation in Creature Collector Fest with a cheeky discount, so don't miss your chance to try out Time to Morp if you’ve always wanted to! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/977510/Time_to_Morp/

Pumped about upcoming patch 1.1? Got any questions, feedback, or you want to report errors?  Don’t hesitate to share through any of our social media channels!

notes.title: The Archive, Morp-Hats, and More – Exciting Update Awaits!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/6bed9ce93f34f57ac4abac83c9838831dcec350a.png

Hello, Interns!
We have a bit more stuff to share with you before Time to Morp will be released from Early Access. From the archive mechanic and Morp-hats to new NPCs and reworked dialogues, there’s plenty to look forward to. Let’s dive into all the fresh content coming your way soon!

The Archive
The Archive is a new mechanic we're adding that lets you store collected resources like seeds, fish, and more to help future explorers! It'll extend gameplay for collectors and completionists while also expanding automation and rewarding players with emotes, skins, and decor.

Don’t forget to show off your rarest finds on a pedestals (newly added items) and flaunt your achievements. We'll try to add everything with the full release, but if not, it'll be available shortly after!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/50c42537dc3567db5061ce7bcd02e9d540515c74.png

New: NPCs
To conclude the game’s story, we’re adding 2 new NPCs, each with their own backgrounds and issues that’ll need your help to solve!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/244096859e5e248b5a938da98531fefde8ed3eab.png

Reworked Dialogues
We’re reworking not only dialogue UI, but we are also adding more lore and personality to each NPC!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/8ef250a2693fbf41329be4446d5aee6d3e56961d.gif

Updated Cozy Look
We are improving several aspects of the game for a cozier look! New changes will include: reworked colors, new models, and revamped UI.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/7ca083ef31a0dcab8a6430e03631c1c96e96b315.gif

Morp-Hats!
A lot of you loved festive Morp-hats, so we’re expanding hats collection and turning it into a new mechanic — we want to let you craft hats and put them on your Morps yourself. And again, we'll try to add everything with the full release, but if not, it'll be available shortly after!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/c20098a59fa11cb2dadf6c4910d9dfccf62249c2.png

Bags of Goods
Sometimes, while doing activities like exploring, mining, fishing, and others, you'll have a chance to find bags of goods filled with rewards like recipes and resources — adding more excitement to the usual gameplay!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/194ec0d075ddfba16368a4a8f756030a375595a0.png

New: Seed Extractor
We’re adding tech to improve the farming experience and bring it closer to full automation! The seed extractor works like this: you feed it your harvest, and it recycles everything into random seeds — plus a little extra, allowing you to hunt for seeds you need and toss unwanted ones back into seed extractor!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/29eec17fc53c6cc986aa886026f5dc0798389b17.gif

New: Decor Extractor
Another new tech, this one lets you convert any resource into currency —  this results in even more automation as you won't need to collect it manually. You can use this currency in NPC shops to buy decor and cool abilities!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/2463f8dab0f5d034395bd3ae3e284672a73d9d12.gif

Even More Lore
We’re adding even more quests that dive into the story of the world and its NPCs, letting you fully immerse in what's happening around you! No spoilers, though.

Join our Socials
Any questions or feedback? Don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us through any of our social media channels!

notes.title: Big Reputation Changes Ahead!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/91034357b9c827d35f9dcef330822e640a7cd8c0.png

Hello, Interns!
We're not slowing down and are still hard at work improving Time to Morp and keeping you updated on the changes! Today’s topic will cover everything related to your reputation  amongst Morps and NPCs — how we are making levelling up of it to be more integrated into the story, updated rewards, new optional events with NPCs, and more. Keep reading to learn all the details!

Level Up Reputation
Deliver food for Morps or NPCs to boost your reputation with them! You can even complete these tasks daily if you want, so no more waiting around. There will be an additional way to level up your reputation with Morps, picture this: you’re running through the forest, spot a sad Morp, pick it up, and suddenly a quest appears: “I’m sad, I need a hug, please!” 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/664b8e5e8965a66cefd61763bf163e9752681a27.gif

Useful Rewards
NPCs will reward you with better tools and more awesome abilities as you level up your reputation with them! Pretty awesome, right?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/dc32e218c53d16332fd52535129480f5db53f544.jpg

Shops
Want more than just the rewards NPCs offer? No problem! Each NPC will have their own shop where you can buy gadgets, rare resources, ingredients, and other unique items!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/6acdd4f4652016da6be681b6bfdf7cff0603d429.png

NPC Areas
Each NPC will want their own cozy space too, completed with fences and decorations to make it look pretty. It should really feel like a charming little village, with each house uniquely decorated and full of personality! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/d97e0635a2d2e401bf8b106b6001624e2c62b4eb.png

Better Reputation = More Lore
The better your reputation with an NPC is, the more they'll trust you and open up about themselves. Optional dialogues will be added for you to explore, giving more backstory on each NPC!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/12170a73057dc7fdb7e0c9d496160d16e65750dc.gif

And There is More!
Here are some other changes we’re planning to add — hopefully right on time:

Level Up your reputation with NPCs by progressing through the main story — become a valuable team member and a respected Intern for all the hard work you’ve put in! 
As you level up your reputation with each NPC, you’ll unlock more and more decor to personalize your space how you like! 
Random events — NPCs might ask you to meet them at a bench to stargaze together, reminisce about the past, or maybe you’ll have to track down an Explorer hanging out on a cliff somewhere...
NPCs will start walking around if you build roads for them! It’ll make the world feel even more alive as they explore their surroundings

notes.title: [0.15.6] Big rebalancing update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/18bbbf58943d4b6b03370cc7f421755e71de70bc.png

Hello Interns!
With the Double the Fun Update release, we got some awesome feedback from the community. The goal of this update was to speed up early game so players can get to more enjoyable aspects, like automation and Morps management, more quickly. We reduced Electron requirements overall, so players won’t need to run back and forth between Electron Veins and their base as much. We also moved Gello requirements and production to later game to cut down standing around and waiting times. We’ve also increased mining speeds and improved production for early game Morps. Overall, the game should involve much less running around and be easier to get into! Check out the full list of changes here:

Researcher

Improved prices: bunch of unlocks no longer require Electrons 
Elevator pipe unlocks along with the Pump now 
Gello Cooker research unlock is now cheaper
Bowl no longer requires Energy Cells to be unlocked
Simple Sprinkler no longer requires Gello to be unlocked
Cooking Pot no longer requires Water to be unlocked (requires Pebbles instead)
Unlocking second Well is easier now 
Chest no longer requires Batteries to be unlocked
Gello Cooker research now requires Protons instead of Electrons
Extractor is cheaper to unlock now
Dispenser is cheaper to unlock now
Seeder requires less Leafs to be unlocked
Well no longer requires Electrons to be unlocked
First Emotes are easier to unlock now

Morps

Young Red Morps and Red Morps produce more resources now
Blue Morps and Better Blue Morps produce more Protons now
Young Red Morps and Blue Morps require less Sugar to evolve 
Tech Morps eat Energy Cells now (check your Areas with them!)
Pink Morps eat Tech Points now (check your Areas with them!)

Extractor Levels

Level 1 is cheaper to unlock and no longer requires Gello
Level 2 is cheaper to unlock and no longer requires Knowledge Points
Level 3 is cheaper to unlock

Questing

Reorganized quests to start with automation sooner

Other

Social Quest "Bring me Fruits" requires 1 entity instead of 5 now
Speed of manual gathering was reduced (Morp production was improved instead)
Collecting resources from Chests is 4 times faster now
Gathering speed of logs is 2 times faster now
Gathering speed for other resources is now adjusted to have similar numbers
Gathering speed of farming Crops is 2 times faster now
Pick-up speed of Extractor is 2 times faster now
Well no longer requires Electrons to be build
Well generates water supply 2 times faster now, gathering speed for water from Well is doubled too
Proton Deposits store 3 times more resources now 
Proton Deposits are doubled at starting location 
Rocks now contain less Pebbles inside
Storage size of Big Simple Chest is doubled now
Chest no longer costs Batteries to build
Production speed of Gello Cookers is doubled 
Crafting of Uprooter and Terraforming Gadgets: prices are halved, output amount of gadgets doubled
Social Quests for Engineer and Mechanic are faster to get now
Reduced the amount of Electrons needed to build a bunch of different Tech
Added FOV slider in options 
Building price for Farming Plot is decreased now
Chests can store Seeds now
Changed logic for Bowls: Simple Pumps now only count resources in Bowls and no longer count resources in the rest of the Area
Elevator pipe is cheaper to build now
Improved descriptions for some Tech
Improved Morp-Wiki descriptions for Blue Morps
Added new quest to build a Pump
Reduced Proton requirements for Tech
It's no longer required to build stairs for the quest

Fixes

Fixed emote sounds in co-op
Fixed mask for some logs that didn't work properly (only affects new save files, old safe files are safe to play still)
Water Stove works properly now when placed near multiple grids
Soap Bubbles now properly affect other players
Soap Bubbles now show actions above the action bar
Seeder sounds in co-op are now fixed
Fixed position for picked entities in co-op
Landing for thrown entities should work properly nowin co-op
Fixed an issue where the right mouse button wouldn't work with action bar while the player is in building mode
After building pump, it now properly switches to building pipe
Morp sounds are no longer playing endlessly in co-op
Toys: playing ball works properly in co-op now
Player skin icons and colors are fixed now for farmer skins
Lost and Found chest can store seeds now
Pipes no longer duplicate in co-op
Feeding Morp after completing Social Quest should no longer break it
Replaced red error with orange warning on Chests
Error icon will now appear above Simple Chests if it is placed outside area

notes.title: [0.15] Double the Fun Update - Live Now!
notes.notes:
Hello, Interns!
The day has finally arrived! We’re landing on Morp planet with patch 0.15, which is live NOW! This update brings not only a fun new mechanics like farming but also enhances your multiplayer experience with cool new toys. Check out the new trailer to see just how exciting the Double the Fun update really is:

[previewyoutube=mN5B6T3PdOs;full][/previewyoutube]
Full List of Changes

New Core Mechanic: Farming
Farming is here, say hello to the new plants that you can plop down anywhere and move at will! Scale your farm infinitely with the help of:

New: Farming Plot
New resources: different types of Seeds and Harvests
New tech: Seed Planter - automate your Farming!

New Mechanic: Abilities

Wings - glide above your base!
Hoverboard - move faster!
Balloons - fly over cliffs
Double Jump
Teleport back to your base
Soap Bubbles - do not aim at your friends!
Hide and Seek - you are a bush? What?

New Mechanic: Toys
New fun ways to interact with your friends in multiplayer, located in decor section:

Trampoline (works with Morps and Resources too)
Football (gate, ball and fireworks when you score)
Mines
Radio
Fireworks

New:

New tech: Dispenser - for better sorting
New tech: Big Chest
New tech: Kite - mark any location on a compass
New Player Skins
New Landmark
New Achievements
New: Brushes for Road building - build 2x2 or more at once!
White Morp abilities: Roll & Sprint
Rare spawns: sleepy Big Boy Morp, underground Morp, tornado Morp, flying Morps (non-interactable for now)
Ripe Flower are now Dark Flower and Bright Flower
Reworked Researcher: new upgrades, new unlocks, adjusted prices and more
Visual Effects - New and Improved

Other:

White Morps can spawn on trees and tech now
White Morps now spawn closer to the player
Doubled Gather speed from Deposits
Improved visuals for Morps underground
Updated model for Treasure Boxes
Removed obsolete gadgets from the game
Ripe Flowers no longer drop Fiber (moved to Farming)
Flowers now drop Seeds needed for Farming
Updated rewards & requirements for the Extractor 
Morp-Wiki now contains information about all Farming resources
Inventory has much more slots now
Added scrollbar to Inventory
Decor: adjusted prices - requires new Farming resources to unlock and build
Player can interact with chairs and benches
It's possible to place Morp on a bench
Decor lamps now emit actual light at night (you can also turn it on and off if needed)
Morp Tower! (carry more Morps)
Better Visual Effects for resources picked up by Cookers and Pumps
Dance emote now plays in a loop
Added screen-shake to some actions
Player rotation is now smoother
Well can store more water
Adjusted prices for all Gadgets
Social Questing: no longer requires fruits, updated quests, increased XP requirement
Removed Inventory Chest (use Chest instead)
Improved UI Popup for Filters (work in progress)
Grass no longer grows under some buildings
Extractor can now pick up resources from a Bowl
Some gadgets require active Radar Tower to be crafted
Alty: more it eats - longer it stays
Increased amount of resources produced by Cloning Gadget
Updated logo in game
Sorting Inventory sorts by type too
Filter popups are sorted now
Compass now shows the angle between player and their target more precisely
Researcher: when search bar is opened - all text is selected
Researcher: improved some icons
Chest now uses less power (20 -> 5)
Improved look for all player skins (added gradients)

Fixes
Mostly based on reports:

No longer possible to load empty saves 
Fixed Pump placing Pipe on occupied cell 
Pipes no longer re-builds on the same cell 
Cursor is no longer shown when controller is active 
Various fixes for Water Tech
When filling with resources, it now plays proper visuals for other Players in Coop
Rotation of entity is saved when copying
Visual Effects should be seen by other Players in Coop
No longer possible to select entity that you can't interact with
Player no longer shifts up/down before/after cutscenes
Thrown on a ground resources should have same position for other Players in Coop
No longer possible to rotate fences, roads, pumps and similar
Morps are loading properly now
Dust particles are no longer increasing their spawn rates based on Player count
Selecting moving entity now properly positions selection icon
Selection icon no longer intersects with warning icons above entities
Water Tech should no longer send water to disconnected towers

Patch Notes (v0.9)
Idea behind this patch is to simplify the early game, giving simple and understandable tools at first, and then replacing them with more advanced technology later in the game.
Another goal is to go more in the direction of “building a town”, adding more NPCs, Housing mechanics and fully reworking how Decor looks and works.

NOTE: Old save files (from v0.8) won't work with the new patch (v0.9)!

New Features:


New Mechanic: Reputation
(Players can complete Quests to increase reputation with Morps and the Crew to get rewards)
New Mechanic: Cooking
(Players can cook complex dishes to feed Morps and the Crew)
New Mechanic: Housing
(Crew members now require a House to stay at. This mechanic will be expanded in future patches)
New Mechanic: Player Emotes
(Players can now use emotes and even Play with Morps!)
New Mechanic: Bowls
(Simple version to move specific items between Areas without dealing with Conditions)
New Progression: All early technology is simplified
(Added simpler versions for all buildings to ensure a smoother learning curve)
New Research Tree: +50% more nodes to unlock
(bloat, bloat, BLOAT)
New Decor: around 40 new items to decorate with
(Decor mechanic was simplified, allowing easier access and building)
New NPCs: Meet 3 new Crew members!
(they're useless right now, but they're there!)

We are excited to announce our next playtest in celebration of the The Tiny Teams Festival, which will be running from now through to August 10th which will feature a whole host of other games made by Tiny Teams, there will be demos, sales live streams and a whole lot for from now until August 10th! 

Check out the Tiny Teams page here - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/423471/view/3721707060686792810

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/b58894746f09aaeec93962523a77006d52e6ac51.png

This is our biggest update yet, and we have a lot of excited things to announce! You can expect to see a lot of great new content and many improvements in this update! You can expect all this and more from this latest update!


Many new mechanics including cooking and housing and Reputation! 
New NPCs with 3 new crew members to meet!
New progression and Research tree!
New Quests!
New Buildings including Roads and Wells
This is just the tip of the iceberg, there are many other amazing features in this update!


You can check out the patch notes for a full list of all the changes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/ba60976acab45a9589bb6f9aeb09fbeef1b31202.png

If you have participated in the previous playtests you will be automatically granted access to this playtest - but if you're new to Time to Morp, simply head over to our store page and hit the request access button to gain access. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/977510/Time_to_Morp/ 

We would love to hear your feedback so feel free to head over to the Steam forums and let us know what you think!

notes.title: New Update! (v0.8)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/3a8a7f5ec63afa0cdb91b80d03b9968239e922a4.png

We coded, we fixed, we coded more, and we delivered! The new version is here! 0.8.1 to be specific! Come and get it!

How to join?
Find "Join the Time to Morp Playtest" on the main page of the game, and press "Request Access" (you will get it immediately).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/77e90a2d8ab423e21f3d27bd3e4362e1811f635d.png

What to expect from the game?
Current version of the game is v0.8, meaning that nothing is final and there is little content to play with. So expect missing mechanics and some imbalance, but you should be able to get the feeling of the game and have fun for several hours!

Where to send feedback?
Start a discussion here on Steam, or join our Discord Server to discuss your experience directly with us in #playtest channel. We will be waiting!

For how long the Playtest will last?
We will close the playtest on March 9th to go through your feedback and then shift our focus back to development.

Patch Notes (v0.8)
In this patch we fully reworked how late-game mechanics work, as well as expanded on Liquid production and transportation. We also updated Player Customization, visuals for NPCs, and added long requested feature: Scan! You can finally find anything on the map! How awesome is that?!

NOTE: Old save files (from v0.7) won't work with the new patch (v0.8)!

New Features:

New Tech: Laser Heater, Water Stove, Smart Sprinklers
New liquid resources and recipes, adding more automation around water
New Mechanic: Scan
Ability to find any Resource/Morp on the Map
Polluted Deposits reworked
Reworked Pollution, allowing for more straight forward automation
Player Customization 2.0
3D faces, gadgets/costumes/glasses, more variations/colors
Morp Wiki 2.0
Progression for unlocks, contains Resources/Environment, possible to show "Related Entities", Diet/Production for Morps, and so on.
Chat 2.0

Improvements:

New NPC models/animations
Cutscenes updated
New Fences
UI/UX: Menus show new/unlocked
New Quests, Tutorials, Research
New Buildings (Stairs, Roads)
Researcher showing type of unlocks
Renderer optimization
Bug fixes / UX improvements
